title: Build the risk scenario before rating it
teachingQuestion: What facts make a risk statement usable for a business decision?
focalInsight: The same weakness can have different consequences and likelihood in different business contexts.
caption: The same weakness can have different consequences and likelihood in different business contexts.

nodes.label: Asset
nodes.definition: Something of value to the organization or its mission.
nodes.decision: Name the business service or information whose loss matters.
nodes.failureExample: The server is listed but its dependency on emergency dispatch is missed.
nodes.detail: Something of value to the organization or its mission.

nodes.label: Threat
nodes.definition: A potential cause of an unwanted incident or adverse consequence.
nodes.decision: Identify the relevant actor, event or circumstance.
nodes.failureExample: A fire and credential theft require different exposure analysis.
nodes.detail: A potential cause of an unwanted incident or adverse consequence.

nodes.label: Vulnerability
nodes.definition: A weakness or condition a threat can exploit.
nodes.decision: Connect the weakness to an actual exposure path.
nodes.failureExample: A vulnerable service is rated without checking whether the attack path reaches it.
nodes.detail: A weakness or condition a threat can exploit.

nodes.label: Likelihood
nodes.definition: An estimate of how plausible or frequent the scenario is in context.
nodes.decision: Use exposure, threat capability, controls and uncertainty.
nodes.failureExample: Historical silence is treated as evidence that exploitation is impossible.
nodes.detail: An estimate of how plausible or frequent the scenario is in context.

nodes.label: Impact
nodes.definition: The consequence if the scenario occurs.
nodes.decision: Assess financial, operational, legal, safety and other relevant harm.
nodes.failureExample: Low replacement cost hides a high cost of lost business service.
nodes.detail: The consequence if the scenario occurs.

nodes.label: Risk assessment
nodes.definition: Evaluate the scenario, likelihood, impact and uncertainty against decision criteria.
nodes.decision: Identify the owner and threshold that will determine treatment.
nodes.failureExample: A qualitative label is presented with spurious numerical precision.
nodes.detail: Evaluate the scenario, likelihood, impact and uncertainty against decision criteria.
